title: Electronic Ear Defenders Impact Sport Shooting Ear Protect Muffs Anti-noise NEW
body_html:
Features:
The built-in orienteering microphone can amplify the range instructions and other ambient sounds to a secure 82 dB, providing more natural listening and enhanced communications.
Active monitoring and auto-close amplification when the ambient sound reaches 82 dB.
With noise reduction level (NRR) of 22dB.
Can be used for the cleaning of the gun stock
Adjustable headband to ensure safety.
Compact folding design is convenient for storage.
Integrated power/ volume knob - Includes AUX input and 3.5 mm connecting cable for MP3 player and scanner.
With auto power off function (when no operation after 4 hours) to extend battery life.
Long battery capacity to play for about 350 hours.

Specification:
Type: Noise-proof Earmuff
Product Weight: Approx. 1 lb
Product size: Approx. 11 * 10 * 4CM(Single earplug)
Battery type: 2 AAA batteries (NOT Included)
Style: earmuffs
Material: ABS plastic
Energy-source: Battery powered
Sound level: 24 dB
Measurement System: English/ Standard
Special function noise reduction level (NRR): 22 dB
Usage: Passive protection
Included component: Impact Sport earmuffs, 3.5 audio connections
Whether include battery: NO
Average battery life: about 350 hours

1 * 3.5MM Audio Cable
1 * Instruction Manual
